correctness.rationale: Let G=K_m x K_n with adjacency when both coordinates differ, m,n>=3. Reconstructed classification: disconnected survivors with an isolate lie in one row/column cross; without isolates an edge in one component forces every vertex of the other into the two cross corners, so exactly a 2x2 rectangle. These four disjoint forms yield D(t)=m[(1+t)^n-1-nt]+n[(1+t)^m-1-mt]+mn t[(1+t)^(m-1)-1][(1+t)^(n-1)-1]+C(m,2)C(n,2)t^4. Maximal disconnected survivor sets are full crosses and 2x2 rectangles; complements are all inclusion-minimal cuts of sizes (m-1)(n-1), mn-4. Independent exhaustive graph search over every labeled survivor subset for 3x3, 3x4, 3x5, 4x4 (sum 2144 disconnected subsets) matched all coefficients and both maximal-cut types; graph proof covers unbounded m,n. Reliability subtraction is exact for independent p survival with nonempty-connected convention.
